limitations: Single fresh AI judge, not independent human review; H1/H3 frozen verdicts unchanged.
Existing automatic claim extractor defines universe; omitted claims/recall not audited.
Strata deliberately enriched; simple agreement is sample-descriptive, not population-weighted accuracy.
Checker flag is answer-level, compared to individual claim judgment; correlated claims and AI systematic bias not captured by Wilson interval.
Evidence consistency review does not verify imported source measurements, applicability or full narrative entailment.
Reviewer cannot be guaranteed blind to style clues in the answer text. Root preparer was exposed to system outputs; judge is a separate fresh-context agent.
